channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Fear of high rent keeps father and daughter living in raft house
item.description: TUMPAT: The devastating floods two years ago have not broken the spirit of fisherman Wan Suhaimi Wan Sulung, 39, who continues to brave the sea despite mounting debt and hardship.

item.title: Activist Heidy Quah hails apex court ruling clearing her over refugee Facebook post
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Activist Heidy Quah has welcomed an apex court ruling clearing her of charges over a 2020 Facebook post on refugees during the Covid-19 outbreak.

item.title: Cement truck overturns near Penang Hospital, driver trapped
item.description: GEORGE TOWN: A cement truck accident at a construction site near Penang Hospital along Jalan Residensi here today has left the driver trapped inside the vehicle.

item.title: Two Perak dams at full capacity despite hot, dry weather
item.description: IPOH: Water levels at two dams in Perak under the supervision of the Perak Water Board (LAP) remain at maximum capacity despite the current hot and dry weather conditions.

item.title: Albert Tei lodges police report against minister over alleged seditious remarks
item.description: PETALING JAYA: Businessman Albert Tei has lodged a police report against a federal minister over remarks he claimed were seditious, threatening, and capable of inciting racial tension.

item.title: Indonesian driver killed after cement truck overturns at construction site
item.description: GEORGE TOWN: A 35-year-old Indonesian man was killed after the cement truck he was driving overturned at a construction site near Penang Hospital along Jalan Residensi here today.

item.title: DVS clears pork imports from Thailand, Brazil ahead of CNY
item.description: PUTRAJAYA: The Department of Veterinary Services (DVS) has approved the import of pork from Thailand and Brazil to meet domestic demand ahead of the Chinese New Year celebration.

item.title: Johor breaks ground first milk processing plant in Mersing
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Johor had taken a major step in boosting Malaysia’s food security with the groundbreaking of its first fully integrated dairy platform Jemaluang Dairy Valley (JDV) milk processing plant in Mersing.

item.title: Unipsas to be rebranded as Universiti Al-Quran, first of its kind in Malaysia
item.description: KUANTAN: The Sultan of Pahang, Al-Sultan Abdullah Ri’ayatuddin Al-Mustafa Billah Shah, has granted his consent for Universiti Islam Pahang Sultan Ahmad Shah (Unipsas) here to be renamed as Universiti Al-Quran, making it the first of its kind in the country.

item.title: UMW Toyota kicks off 2026 with 4,700 units sold in January
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: UMW Toyota Motor Sdn Bhd sold 4,700 units in January, marking a steady opening for the year amid a competitive market environment.
